info.title: Zones
info.description:
Every independently addressable zone Extole's v10 component library ships. A zone is identified by the same name as a business event — the component's `event_names` — and rendered against your own program domain.

**Preview for the ENG-30863 design review, not a merge candidate.** Generated from the component inventory; no component declares `operations[]` yet.

program_domain.description: Your program domain, as shown in My Extole.

post.description:
Renders the `global_header` zone. Defined by the `call_to_action instance` component in Extole's v10 component library.

Also addressable as: `promotion_viewed`.

schema.description: Targeting and input data passed to the zone's creative.

200.description: Rendered zone content. The body shape varies by the zone's creative — HTML, JavaScript, JSON or plain text.
